name: anamnesis
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — deterministic capture via lifecycle hooks. Per-user encrypted, visible, deletable. 0.3.0 migrates the MCP connector to OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + DCR per MCP 2025-11-25: first connect opens a browser for consent on anamnesis.smtry.ai, tokens live in the system keychain, no handle in URL. Hook auth still uses X-Anamnesis-Key pending a separate migration before the 2026-05-20 legacy cutoff.
